audit_status.source_base: Hebrew 1 Chronicles / Divrei Hayamim Aleph public succession charge and temple plans, first-pass restored draft; later witness audit required
audit_status.review_note: Reviewed for public succession pressure, David's bloodshed, chosen-king language, conditional covenant, heart-searching, Solomon's youth, spiritualized architectural plans, material weights, skilled labor, royal command, and sanctuary symbolism.

verses.restored: David assembled at Jerusalem all leaders of Israel: tribal leaders, division commanders serving king, commanders of thousands and hundreds, officials over all property and livestock of king and sons, court officials, mighty warriors, and every able person.

familiar.text: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.

verses.restored: King David stood on feet and said, Hear me, my brothers and my people. It was in my heart to build resting house for ark of covenant of YHWH and footstool of our Divine, and I prepared to build.

familiar.text: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: As for me, I had in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:

verses.restored: But Divine said to me, You shall not build a house for my name, because you are a man of wars and have shed blood.

familiar.text: But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou hast been a man of war, and hast shed blood.

verses.restored: Yet YHWH Divine of Israel chose me from all father's house to be king over Israel enduringly; chose Judah as leader, house of Judah, house of my father, and among father's sons delighted to make me king over all Israel.

familiar.text: Howbeit the LORD God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah to be the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Israel:

verses.restored: From all my sons—for YHWH gave me many sons—YHWH chose Solomon my son to sit on throne of kingdom of YHWH over Israel.

familiar.text: And of all my sons, (for the LORD hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.

verses.restored: YHWH said to me, Solomon your son shall build my house and courts, for I have chosen him as son and I will be father to him.

familiar.text: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

verses.restored: I will establish his kingdom enduringly if he is strong to do my commandments and judgments, as this day.

familiar.text: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.

verses.restored: Now, before eyes of all Israel, assembly of YHWH, and in hearing of our Divine, guard and seek all commandments of YHWH your Divine, so you may possess good land and leave it as inheritance to children after you enduringly.

familiar.text: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the LORD, and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the LORD your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.

verses.restored: You, Solomon my son, know Divine of your father and serve with whole heart and willing soul, for YHWH searches all hearts and understands every formation of thoughts. If you seek, you will find; if you abandon, you will be rejected enduringly.

familiar.text: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.

verses.restored: See now, for YHWH has chosen you to build a house for sanctuary. Be strong and act.

familiar.text: Take heed now; for the LORD hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.

verses.restored: David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and courageous and act; do not fear or be dismayed, for YHWH Divine, my Divine, is with you. YHWH will not fail or abandon you until all work for service of house of YHWH is finished.

familiar.text: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the LORD God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD.

verses.restored: Look, divisions of priests and Levites for all service of house of Divine; with you for all work are every willing person skilled in every craft, and officials and all people are at your command.

familiar.text: And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God: and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment.

translation_notes: The succession and temple commission occur before a massive public assembly, creating intense pressure on Solomon to accept a role chosen by father and institution.
David again states that warfare and bloodshed disqualify him from building; chosen status does not erase this moral limit.
Claims that David, Judah, and Solomon are chosen belong to ancient covenantal theology and do not create hereditary divine right or immunity.
The kingdom promise is explicitly conditional upon justice and commandments, despite idealizing language.
Divine heart-searching is a theological claim, not permission for leaders to surveil thoughts, demand disclosure, or control conscience.
The plans are attributed to spirit and writing. Spiritual inspiration does not replace architecture, engineering, fire safety, accessibility, labor law, budgets, and independent review.
Detailed gold and silver weights expose immense wealth and resource concentration.
Cherubim and chariot imagery are sacred symbolism, not occult or mechanical instructions.
Workers are described as willing and skilled, yet also placed at Solomon's command; true willingness must remain revocable and protected from royal coercion.
The assembly includes property and military officials but does not demonstrate broad participation by women, poor people, workers, or prior inhabitants.
safety_note: Do not use chosen status, heart-searching, spiritual blueprints, royal command, or temple grandeur to justify authoritarianism, surveillance, unsafe design, coerced labor, or leader cult. Center Solomon's youth and consent, David's disqualification, workers' freedom, accessibility, engineering, and financial accountability.
